evidence.description: Customer states: 'I never made this $482.12 purchase. Please check my card.'
Login to the account occurred from a new device shortly before the transaction, followed by a contact-detail change
Device not previously associated with this customer's account
Same mixed-channel anomaly signature (new device login + contact change + purchase) confirmed as account takeover in 2 recent closed cases

case.reasoning: A customer denial combined with a new-device login immediately preceding a contact-detail change and the purchase is the account-takeover signature seen in prior confirmed cases. This is a direct customer denial (policy R2), not a weak single signal, so no additional verification step was required before blocking.

sar.reason: Exposure ($482.12) is below the $1,000 threshold and no shared-device link to another customer was found

initial.justification: Policy R2: customer denies the transaction — block the card. Exposure ($482.12) is ≤ $2,500, routing to L1. CREATE_CASE is also recommended alongside this action.

final.justification: Account-takeover signature confirmed against 2 prior cases after reviewing login and contact-change history. Recommendation unchanged from initial — policy R2 block stands, still routed to L1.

evidence_requests: Account login and contact-detail change history for the 48 hours before the transaction
stop_reason: Customer denial plus a matching account-takeover signature against two confirmed prior cases is sufficient for a defensible block; exposure does not meet the SAR threshold.
